notes.title: V0.2.01 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2][b]Latest Update:[/b][/h2][p]1.Fixed and optimized the knockback logic to prevent enemies from being pushed outside rooms.[/p][p]2.Resolved an issue where stealing in shops could not be interrupted.[/p][p]3.Fixed an abnormality with the health bar display option.[/p][p]4.Improved the trigger effect in the Kitchen area—now it drops food-related items.[/p][p]5.Added an auto-hide mouse cursor setting.[/p][p]6.Optimized performance in specific lag-prone scenarios[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue listening to your feedback, fixing issues, and polishing the experience to make the game even better.[/p][p]Thank you for all your support and companionship throughout this journey![/p][h3][b]— Bold Fish —[/b][/h3]

notes.title: V0.2 Major Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p align="start"]Since the last release, the game has undergone many changes. To provide a better experience for our demo players, we’ve rolled out a new update focused on overall optimization and refinement, aiming to improve the game’s completeness and smoothness. Although this update isn’t heavily content-driven, we’re continuously working to expand the game—more major updates are planned for the final demo version.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🆕 Additions：[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fast Travel System[/b]: Makes movement quicker and exploration smoother![/p][/*][*][p][b]6 New Relics[/b]: A first batch of new content—more to come in the future. Stay tuned![/p][/*][*][p][b]Black Market[/b]: A mysterious shop is now open. Be sure to see what unique items are available![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ Optimizations：[/h3][list][*][p][b]Comprehensive Music Upgrade[/b]: All background music has been replaced to enhance immersion and atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Visual Effects[/b]: Optimized overall visual performance for a more refined and polished look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance Adjustments[/b]: Slightly reduced damage for certain ranged weapons to maintain combat balance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p align="start"]In addition, we’ve made a range of subtle tweaks and under-the-hood improvements. While these may not be immediately noticeable, they help deliver a more stable gameplay experience.[/p][p align="start"]The game is still in active development, and we greatly appreciate your patience and support. We’re taking things step by step and welcome everyone’s feedback![/p][p align="start"]We’ll continue listening to your suggestions, addressing issues, and refining the game to deliver a more polished experience. Thank you for your continued companionship and support![/p][p][/p][p][b]-BOLD FISH-[/b][/p]

notes.title: V0.1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2][b]Latest Update:[/b][/h2][p]1.Fixed an issue where chests could block doors[/p][p]2.Fixed QQ group button not linking correctly[/p][p]3.Adjusted chest drop rates[/p][p]4.Improved collision damage feedback[/p][p]5.Reworked the “Fermentation Relic”: brewing with non-attributed items now generates random attributes[/p][p]6.Optimized performance in specific lag-prone scenarios[/p][p]7.Replaced the Pollen Monster with the Meatball Monster[/p][p]8.Added: Unpicked items now show on the map[/p][p]9.Added: Keybinding customization[/p][p]10.Added: Sprint toggle feature (hold or toggle sprint)[/p][p]11.Minor polish and tweaks[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue listening to your feedback, fixing issues, and polishing the experience to make the game even better.[/p][p]Thank you for all your support and companionship throughout this journey![/p][h3][b]— Bold Fish —[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Bait Soul – Demo V0.1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear players,[/b][/h3]

Hello from Thick Fish Studio!
Thank you so much for your continued support and valuable feedback. We've been hard at work improving the demo to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience for everyone. Here's a summary of the latest fixes and improvements:

[h1]Update Summary:[/h1]

1.Fixed an issue where the item attack range was displayed incorrectly
2.Resolved a bug where the frog jump could cause players to exit the map
3.Fixed repeated triggering of the mini-boss "Gravekeeper"
4.Fixed abnormal display issues on the results screen
5.Corrected the controller prompt image for the Dash ability
6.Fixed misplaced drop chest positions
7.Resolved an issue where shop items could block price tags
8.Improved hints and guidance related to rice grain items
9.Optimized logic for breaking objects with the Blink skill
10.Added vertical sync (V-Sync) setting to improve screen stability

We deeply appreciate everyone who tried the demo and shared their thoughts. Your support is what drives us forward. We're continuing to fix bugs, polish the game, and develop new content to make the full version of Bait Soul worth the wait!

Feel free to join our community and let us know what you think—we’d love to hear from you!

With gratitude,
[h3][b]-Bold Fish-[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Bait Soul Demo Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear players,[/b][/h3]

[h1]The demo for our latest game Bait Soul is now officially live![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689970/_Bait_Soul_Demo/

This is an adventure about liberation. In the depths of an unknown dungeon, you'll take control of a character equipped with Blink, Sprint, and Auto-Attack abilities to fight powerful enemies, explore secret rooms, and create a unique combat style through the Soul Orb system and support items.

This demo features the first stage, allowing you to fully experience the core gameplay and foundational systems.

If you enjoy dungeon games that blend exploration and action, please don’t forget to add us to your wishlist — your support is what keeps us moving forward!

Thank you to everyone who tries the demo. We warmly welcome your feedback and suggestions. We’ll continue developing future content and polishing the game for a better experience.

[h3][b]-BOLD FISH-[/b][/h3]

notes.title: The Steam store page for 'Bait Soul' is now live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Players,[/b][/h1]

[h2]Happy New Year! We’re excited to finally share our new game — Bait Soul — with you at this special time![/h2]

Bait Soul is a top-down action roguelike where players can freely combine various elements to create their own ultimate combat style. Explore the unknown depths and face waves of formidable enemies in a challenging journey.
